EmailTemplate.subject: Help Ensure a Safe Blood Supply and Stronger Community
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear [Insert Name],
As a person in service to patient care every day, no one could have a better understanding of the unexpected turns a day can bring, or the impact of a ready blood supply versus a blood shortage. As part of your dedication to every avenue that could provide lifesaving care, the American Red Cross invites you to lead a blood program. The rewards of service go far beyond even the profound benefit to patients. Sharing in community service offers unique opportunities for [Company Name].
· The American Red Cross offers the opportunity to demonstrate a rewarding and visible contribution to the community through partnership with one of the most trusted and recognized brands associated with health, preparation, and human compassion.
· Lead the community by example. Show that a healthy blood supply is the responsibility of every eligible donor, even those already helping profoundly in other ways.
· Group volunteer opportunities promote teamwork, boost employee morale and provide productive social outlets, particularly helpful for high stakes work environments.
As trusted medical practitioners, your opportunity to engage new donors is unique. You can have a particularly meaningful impact on blood readiness for years to come. Let’s work together to protect a vital blood supply for all in need. If you can sponsor a blood drive program, If you can sponsor a blood drive program, please contact me at your earliest convenience to schedule.
Sincerely,
[Insert Name]
P.S. If you are unable to host an on-site blood drive, please visit RedCrossBlood.org/SleevesUp to host a virtual drive or refer another host today.
